This game's own lesson: scoring came in at ×0.639 of the raw projection, and the home side beat its projected margin by -1.4 goals. It counts toward Soccer scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections.

Across 1824 graded Soccer games the algo now scales scoring ×0.940 and gives home teams 0 goals. Team corrections so far: Defensor attack ×1.040, defense ×1.008 (8 games); Juventud attack ×1.029, defense ×0.996 (9 games).
